# Vatsalya Bhadaurya

> Vatsalya Bhadaurya is an AI Engineer specializing in humanoid robotics, multimodal
> perception, on-device inference, and embodied AI. He builds Vision-Language-Action
> (VLA) systems deployed on real robots — not simulations — and is an IEEE-published
> researcher. Based in India.

## Who he is

- **Name:** Vatsalya Bhadaurya
- **Role:** AI Engineer at iHub Research & Robotics Pvt Ltd (promoted from AI Intern, R&D)
- **Founder:** Nextgen Research Lab & Infrastructure Development Pvt. Ltd. (https://nextgenrl.com/)
- **Focus:** Humanoid perception & behavior, on-device ML, VLM/VLA pipelines, edge AI on NVIDIA Jetson
- **Education:** B.Tech Computer Science, Gautam Buddha University (expected 2028)
- **Location:** India — open to research & engineering roles
- **Website:** https://vatsalyaaa.me/
- **Email:** vatbhadaurya@gmail.com

## Core expertise

AI & ML: VLA, VLM, YOLOv8, CNNs, Transformers, Whisper, VAD, TensorFlow, OpenCV, DINOv3,
SAM 2.1, Depth Anything, DUSt3R, GPT-OSS, LLaVA-style models.
Robotics & Perception: ROS2, rclcpp, multimodal fusion, speech-to-intent-to-action, SLAM,
behavior trees. Hardware: Jetson AGX / Orin Nano, Blackwell, STM32, ESP32-S3, Arduino,
Raspberry Pi, sensor fusion, Docker, Linux. Software & Cloud: Python, C/C++, Kotlin/Java,
TypeScript, FastAPI, Flask, Next.js/React, ESP-IDF, Gemini API, multi-agent orchestration,
Supabase, Firebase.

## Experience

- **AI Engineer**, iHub Research & Robotics (Sep 2026 – present): VLA systems for the TARA
  humanoid platforms; research-paper publications with the R&D team.
- **AI Intern, R&D**, iHub Research & Robotics (Jul 2025 – Aug 2026): humanoid perception
  pipelines (DINOv3, SAM 2.1, Depth Anything, DUSt3R); speech→intent→action with Whisper;
  VLA behavior engine for TARA Care & TARA Edu; Jetson Orin Nano deployment; TVS Automobiles
  alloy-defect & paint-anomaly vision.
- **Software Developer Intern**, Gautam Buddha University (Dec 2024 – present).
- **Community Speaker**, Arduino (2022 – 2025).

## Selected work

- [GangaDrishti — IEEE paper](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11469066): real-time
  multimodal microplastic detection sensor (multispectral optics, impedance spectroscopy,
  500x microscopy on ESP32-S3; YOLOv8-C + attention fusion; 8-bit TFLite <200 ms). IEEE
  IC3ECSBHI 2026. Project: https://microplastic.vatsalyaaa.me
- [vla.cpp](https://github.com/VinRobotics/vla.cpp): open-source C++ inference runtime for
  VLA models; two merged PRs (#12 Windows/WSL2+CUDA build path, #17 LIBERO evaluation).
- [MaaKosh](https://nextgenrl.com/): AI maternal & newborn wearable (fetal tracking, PPH,
  temperature, jaundice detection), tested at RML Hospital, Delhi.
- [VitaSense](https://vitasense.nextgenrl.com/): offline-first pediatric screening for ASHA
  workers; India Top 16, BioMed Bharat 2026.
- [FoundryBuild](https://foundrybuild.xyz): multi-agent "AI CTO" — 11-agent pipeline that
  turns an idea into an engineering blueprint.
- SecondMind (ESP32-S3 AI pendant, 2nd place hackathon), BoloNyay (multilingual legal AI,
  India Top 100), TARA Care & TARA Edu (humanoid platforms).
